functions.name: Conv_AudioOutputDeviceInfoToString
functions.signature: Conv_AudioOutputDeviceInfoToString(Info)

functions.name: AddMasterSubmixEffect
functions.signature: AddMasterSubmixEffect(World Context Object, Submix Effect Preset)
functions.docs: Adds a submix effect preset to the master submix.

functions.name: RemoveMasterSubmixEffect
functions.signature: RemoveMasterSubmixEffect(World Context Object, Submix Effect Preset)
functions.docs: Removes a submix effect preset from the master submix.

functions.name: ClearMasterSubmixEffects
functions.signature: ClearMasterSubmixEffects(World Context Object)
functions.docs: Clears all master submix effects.

functions.name: AddSubmixEffect
functions.signature: AddSubmixEffect(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Effect Preset)
functions.docs: Adds a submix effect preset to the given submix at the end of its submix effect chain. Returns the number of submix effects.

functions.name: RemoveSubmixEffectPreset
functions.signature: RemoveSubmixEffectPreset(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Effect Preset)

functions.name: RemoveSubmixEffect
functions.signature: RemoveSubmixEffect(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Effect Preset)
functions.docs: Removes all instances of a submix effect preset from the given submix.

functions.name: RemoveSubmixEffectPresetAtIndex
functions.signature: RemoveSubmixEffectPresetAtIndex(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Chain Index)

functions.name: RemoveSubmixEffectAtIndex
functions.signature: RemoveSubmixEffectAtIndex(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Chain Index)
functions.docs: Removes the submix effect at the given submix chain index, if there is a submix effect at that index.

functions.name: ReplaceSoundEffectSubmix
functions.signature: ReplaceSoundEffectSubmix(World Context Object, In Sound Submix, Submix Chain Index, Submix Effect Preset)

functions.name: ReplaceSubmixEffect
functions.signature: ReplaceSubmixEffect(World Context Object, In Sound Submix, Submix Chain Index, Submix Effect Preset)
functions.docs: Replaces the submix effect at the given submix chain index, adds the effect if there is none at that index.

functions.name: ClearSubmixEffects
functions.signature: ClearSubmixEffects(World Context Object, Sound Submix)
functions.docs: Clears all submix effects on the given submix.

functions.name: SetSubmixEffectChainOverride
functions.signature: SetSubmixEffectChainOverride(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Submix Effect Preset Chain, Fade Time Sec)
functions.docs: Sets a submix effect chain override on the given submix. The effect chain will cross fade from the base effect chain or current override to the new override.

functions.name: ClearSubmixEffectChainOverride
functions.signature: ClearSubmixEffectChainOverride(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Fade Time Sec)
functions.docs: Clears all submix effect overrides on the given submix and returns it to the default effect chain.

functions.name: StartRecordingOutput
functions.signature: StartRecordingOutput(World Context Object, Expected Duration, Submix To Record)
functions.docs: Start recording audio. By leaving the Submix To Record field blank, you can record the master output of the game.

functions.name: StopRecordingOutput
functions.signature: StopRecordingOutput(World Context Object, Export Type, Name, Path, Submix To Record, Existing Sound Wave To Overwrite)
functions.docs: Stop recording audio. Path can be absolute, or relative (to the /Saved/BouncedWavFiles folder). By leaving the Submix To Record field blank, you can record the master output of the game.

functions.name: PauseRecordingOutput
functions.signature: PauseRecordingOutput(World Context Object, Submix To Pause)
functions.docs: Pause recording audio, without finalizing the recording to disk. By leaving the Submix To Record field blank, you can record the master output of the game.

functions.name: ResumeRecordingOutput
functions.signature: ResumeRecordingOutput(World Context Object, Submix To Pause)
functions.docs: Resume recording audio after pausing. By leaving the Submix To Pause field blank, you can record the master output of the game.

functions.name: StartAnalyzingOutput
functions.signature: StartAnalyzingOutput(World Context Object, Submix To Analyze, FFT Size, Interpolation Method, Window Type, Hop Size, Spectrum Type)
functions.docs: Start spectrum analysis of the audio output. By leaving the Submix To Analyze blank, you can analyze the master output of the game.

functions.name: StopAnalyzingOutput
functions.signature: StopAnalyzingOutput(World Context Object, Submix To Stop Analyzing)
functions.docs: Stop spectrum analysis.

functions.name: MakeMusicalSpectralAnalysisBandSettings
functions.signature: MakeMusicalSpectralAnalysisBandSettings(In Num Semitones, In Starting Musical Note, In Starting Octave, In Attack Time Msec, In Release Time Msec)

functions.name: MakeFullSpectrumSpectralAnalysisBandSettings
functions.signature: MakeFullSpectrumSpectralAnalysisBandSettings(In Num Bands, In Minimum Frequency, In Maximum Frequency, In Attack Time Msec, In Release Time Msec)

functions.name: MakePresetSpectralAnalysisBandSettings
functions.signature: MakePresetSpectralAnalysisBandSettings(In Band Preset Type, In Num Bands, In Attack Time Msec, In Release Time Msec)

functions.name: GetMagnitudeForFrequencies
functions.signature: GetMagnitudeForFrequencies(World Context Object, Frequencies, Magnitudes, Submix To Analyze)
functions.docs: Retrieve the magnitudes for the given frequencies.

functions.name: GetPhaseForFrequencies
functions.signature: GetPhaseForFrequencies(World Context Object, Frequencies, Phases, Submix To Analyze)
functions.docs: Retrieve the phases for the given frequencies.

functions.name: AddSourceEffectToPresetChain
functions.signature: AddSourceEffectToPresetChain(World Context Object, Preset Chain, Entry)
functions.docs: Adds source effect entry to preset chain. Only effects the instance of the preset chain

functions.name: RemoveSourceEffectFromPresetChain
functions.signature: RemoveSourceEffectFromPresetChain(World Context Object, Preset Chain, Entry Index)
functions.docs: Removes source effect entry from preset chain. Only affects the instance of preset chain.

functions.name: SetBypassSourceEffectChainEntry
functions.signature: SetBypassSourceEffectChainEntry(World Context Object, Preset Chain, Entry Index, Bypassed)
functions.docs: Set whether or not to bypass the effect at the source effect chain index.

functions.name: GetNumberOfEntriesInSourceEffectChain
functions.signature: GetNumberOfEntriesInSourceEffectChain(World Context Object, Preset Chain)
functions.docs: Returns the number of effect chain entries in the given source effect chain.

functions.name: PrimeSoundForPlayback
functions.signature: PrimeSoundForPlayback(Sound Wave, On Load Completion)
functions.docs: Begin loading a sound into the cache so that it can be played immediately.

functions.name: PrimeSoundCueForPlayback
functions.signature: PrimeSoundCueForPlayback(Sound Cue)
functions.docs: Begin loading any sounds referenced by a sound cue into the cache so that it can be played immediately.

functions.name: TrimAudioCache
functions.signature: TrimAudioCache(In Megabytes To Free)
functions.docs: Trim memory used by the audio cache. Returns the number of megabytes freed.

functions.name: StartAudioBus
functions.signature: StartAudioBus(World Context Object, Audio Bus)
functions.docs: Starts the given audio bus.

functions.name: StopAudioBus
functions.signature: StopAudioBus(World Context Object, Audio Bus)
functions.docs: Stops the given audio bus.

functions.name: IsAudioBusActive
functions.signature: IsAudioBusActive(World Context Object, Audio Bus)
functions.docs: Queries if the given audio bus is active (and audio can be mixed to it).

functions.name: RegisterAudioBusToSubmix
functions.signature: RegisterAudioBusToSubmix(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Audio Bus)
functions.docs: Registers an audio bus to a submix so the submix output can be routed to the audiobus.

functions.name: UnregisterAudioBusFromSubmix
functions.signature: UnregisterAudioBusFromSubmix(World Context Object, Sound Submix, Audio Bus)
functions.docs: Unregisters an audio bus that could have been registered to a submix.

functions.name: GetAvailableAudioOutputDevices
functions.signature: GetAvailableAudioOutputDevices(World Context Object, On Obtain Devices Event)
functions.docs:
Gets information about all audio output devices available in the system
@param OnObtainDevicesEvent - the event to fire when the audio endpoint devices have been retrieved

functions.name: GetCurrentAudioOutputDeviceName
functions.signature: GetCurrentAudioOutputDeviceName(World Context Object, On Obtain Current Device Event)
functions.docs:
Gets information about the currently used audio output device
@param OnObtainCurrentDeviceEvent - the event to fire when the audio endpoint devices have been retrieved

functions.name: SwapAudioOutputDevice
functions.signature: SwapAudioOutputDevice(World Context Object, New Device Id, On Completed Device Swap)
